description: A twelve channel stereo mixer with two mono aux sends, two stereo aux returns, and a level, a pan, two send amounts and a mute on every channel

params.text: Scales the stereo mix and the two returns together, silent at fully counter-clockwise and unchanged fully clockwise
Scales that aux send output, silent at fully counter-clockwise and unchanged fully clockwise
Scales that aux return into the stereo mix, silent at fully counter-clockwise and unchanged fully clockwise
Scales that channel, silent at fully counter-clockwise and unchanged fully clockwise
Places that channel in the stereo image, hard left at fully counter-clockwise, even between the two sides at the centre and hard right fully clockwise
Sets how much of that channel goes to the first aux send
Sets how much of that channel goes to the second aux send
Turns that channel on and off, and lights while the channel is passing signal

inputs.text: Scales that channel on top of its level knob, 0V silencing it and 10V leaving it alone, and is then applied a second time to that channel's two aux sends
Moves that channel's pan on top of its pan knob, -5V for hard left and 5V for hard right
Stops that channel while this reads above 0V, whatever its mute button is set to
The left side of that aux return
The right side of that aux return

outputs.text: The left side of the stereo mix, with the left side of both aux returns added in
The right side of the stereo mix, with the right side of both aux returns added in
Every channel at the amount its first send knob is set to, scaled by the first send knob in the master section
Every channel at the amount its second send knob is set to, scaled by the second send knob in the master section

notes: a channel is read only while a cable is patched to its input, and every channel level knob comes up at zero, so a new mixer is silent until the levels are raised
the two aux sends come out as one jack each and the two aux returns take a left and a right; a return is added to the stereo mix and never to a send
the lit state of a mute button is the passing state: a channel stopped by its button or by its mute input shows no light
